ITEM 1 | Dark purple-black drupelet berries, clustered in a rounded mound of about 10 individual pieces, glossy with small red-tinted spots on some drupelets, firm and plump, sitting on the left-center of the plate; footprint roughly 25% of plate width across the cluster, about 6 cm across, roughly 3 cm tall | 60
ITEM 2 | Three golden-brown, bumpy, irregular pieces with a dry, slightly crusty surface, one larger rounded piece about 3.5 cm across with green flecks, one smaller piece about 2.5 cm, and one glossy caramel-colored piece about 3 cm with a sheen, arranged on the right side of the plate, not touching the berries | 55
